messages:
Maria L.: quick design check — dropdown for notification channels + suppression preview. current mock groups channels by type but the preview doesn’t show exactly who gets notified when multiple channels overlap. screenshot: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/alert-preview.png
Samir: agree — grouping is ok but we need an explicit 'effective recipients' row in the preview. otherwise people get surprised. also keyboard nav: group headers should be skip-toable. :keyboard:
Alex P.: can we show a tiny example line per channel? e.g. `Slack: #infra-alerts (mentions @oncall)` `PagerDuty: infra-team-oncall` `Email: infra-oncall@example.com` That makes it obvious.
Denise (Design): wording nit: currently says "Notify when threshold is met" — propose "Alert when threshold is reached" to match product copy. also thoughts on showing suppression windows inline vs a separate modal?
Ellie (Accessibility): suppression preview must announce changes via aria-live and move focus to the preview when you toggle suppression. keyboard users should be able to tab into the preview and read the effective recipient list. also ensure color alone is not used to indicate suppressed vs active.
Maria L.: good points. question: if a channel mapping routes the same alert to multiple endpoints (eg: slack -> email + webhook), do we expand both in the preview or collapse into "3 recipients" with a expand arrow?
Samir: expand by default for the first two channels and collapse after that? i'd prefer explicit expansion so infra teams see exact endpoints at glance. maybe show the first 2 recipients and a "+N more" link.
Alex P.: UX microcopy for +N more: use "+2 more recipients" not just "+2" — clearer. Also add a tiny hover/tooltip showing why they’re being notified (mapping rule name).
Denise (Design): mock update: I'll change the preview row to show up to 3 explicit recipients, then a `+N more` with tooltip. suppression pill will show reason + snooze window. Copy: "Suppressed — 1h until re-enable" vs just "Suppressed".
Ellie (Accessibility): tooltip must be accessible (focusable and announced). For `+N more` ensure it receives focus and expands the aria-live region with the full list.
Maria L.: small implementation detail — for performance we should fetch preview recipients client-side when the preview panel opens (not on every keystroke). ok?
Samir: yes, lazy load preview with a spinner state. serverside we compute resolved recipients by applying routing rules + suppression rules. please ensure we include cancelled routes in the preview and mark them as "suppressed by rule: <name>" where applicable.
Alex P.: example payload we can show in the UI dev story (code block):
```
PreviewRecipients: [
  "slack:#infra-alerts (mapped by: primary-routing)",
  "pagerduty:infra-oncall (mapped by: p90escalation)",
  "email:infra-oncall@example.com"
]
Suppression: "scheduled maintenance (ends 2024-06-10T15:00Z)"
```
Denise (Design): small accessibility copy tweak: when suppression is active, prepend the preview with "(Suppressed)" so screenreaders encounter the state immediately.
Ellie (Accessibility): yes, prepend and ensure the aria-label equals the full human string, e.g. `aria-label="Suppressed: scheduled maintenance until June 10, 2024"`.
ops-bot: deploy-bot — design mock updated at https://figma.redwood.app/file/alert-preview/v2 (published to staging).
Maria L.: decisions summary: 1) Preview shows up to 3 explicit recipients + "+N more recipients" (focusable) 2) Suppression displays inline with reason + end time 3) aria-live + aria-labels for suppression state and expansion 4) lazy-load preview on panel open with spinner 5) copy change: "Alert when threshold is reached". Denise to update figma, Ellie to add a11y checklist, Alex to add example payload in the dev story, Samir will coordinate server rules.
Denise (Design): got it — i'll push the figma updates and drop a link once done. :thumbsup:
Ellie (Accessibility): i'll add the checklist and a quick keyboard walkthrough to the ticket.
Samir: i'll add a backend ticket for resolved recipients + suppression annotations.
Maria L.: thanks all — will close this thread once figma link and tickets are in place. :sparkles:
